comparison_step: first step with two consecutive observed impaired windows; exclude unavailable answers and retain exclusion counts
positive_gate: native PASS and injector confirmation and independently observed impact
healthy_controls: recorded snapshots before observed impairment; detector false alarms separately reported
ranking_yield: UNKNOWN: no captured diagnostic execution results; no invented counterfactuals
confidence_policy: uncalibrated; no learned thresholds; noul 0.5 only indicates evidence preference
sample_limits: 8 whole runs, 4 holdout runs; repeated Redis partition correlated; no population generalization
